description: Full cross-domain dataset — all available episodes for every RM, PC, and FA subtask. RM: 4 subtasks × 40 = 160 episodes. PC: 5 subtasks × 40 = 200 episodes. FA: normalization 244 + earnings_quality 1002 + driver_decomposition 997 = 2243 episodes. Excludes PC infeasibility_detection (unsupported schema).
selection_method: All episode files present in data/{domain}/episodes/layer_a/<subtask>/, sorted by task_id within each subtask, domain order: RM → PC → FA.
